titleEn: Total Cost to Hire K Workers
title: 雇佣 K 位工人的总代价
summary: 每轮从当前最左 candidates 人和最右 candidates 人中按代价、再按下标最小者雇佣，求 k 轮总代价。
insight: 左右各用一个按 [cost,index] 排序的小根堆，仅在对应一侧有人被取走时补入下一个尚未入堆的人，即可精确模拟候选窗口。
pitfalls: 候选区重叠时同一人只能入堆一次
代价相同按原下标较小者

solutions.title: 左右候选双小根堆
solutions.idea: 双指针控制尚未进入候选区的区间。
steps: 把左侧至多 candidates 人加入 leftHeap
从右侧且未与左侧重叠的位置加入 rightHeap
重复 k 次，比较两个堆顶的 cost 与 index，弹出较小者
从被弹出的一侧补入一个新候选并累加成本

code.java: class Solution { private int compare(int[] a,int[] b){return a[0]!=b[0]?Integer.compare(a[0],b[0]):Integer.compare(a[1],b[1]);}public long totalCost(int[] costs,int k,int candidates){PriorityQueue<int[]> leftHeap=new PriorityQueue<>(this::compare),rightHeap=new PriorityQueue<>(this::compare);int left=0,right=costs.length-1;while(left<=right&&leftHeap.size()<candidates){leftHeap.offer(new int[]{costs[left],left});left++;}while(left<=right&&rightHeap.size()<candidates){rightHeap.offer(new int[]{costs[right],right});right--;}long answer=0;while(k-->0){boolean takeLeft=rightHeap.isEmpty()||!leftHeap.isEmpty()&&compare(leftHeap.peek(),rightHeap.peek())<=0;int[] chosen=takeLeft?leftHeap.poll():rightHeap.poll();answer+=chosen[0];if(left<=right){if(takeLeft){leftHeap.offer(new int[]{costs[left],left});left++;}else{rightHeap.offer(new int[]{costs[right],right});right--;}}}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun totalCost(costs:IntArray,kValue:Int,candidates:Int):Long{val order=compareBy<IntArray>{it[0]}.thenBy{it[1]};val leftHeap=java.util.PriorityQueue(order);val rightHeap=java.util.PriorityQueue(order);var left=0;var right=costs.lastIndex;while(left<=right&&leftHeap.size<candidates){leftHeap.offer(intArrayOf(costs[left],left));left++};while(left<=right&&rightHeap.size<candidates){rightHeap.offer(intArrayOf(costs[right],right));right--};var k=kValue;var answer=0L;while(k-->0){val takeLeft=rightHeap.isEmpty()||leftHeap.isNotEmpty()&&order.compare(leftHeap.peek(),rightHeap.peek())<=0;val chosen=if(takeLeft)leftHeap.poll()else rightHeap.poll();answer+=chosen[0];if(left<=right){if(takeLeft){leftHeap.offer(intArrayOf(costs[left],left));left++}else{rightHeap.offer(intArrayOf(costs[right],right));right--}}};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:long long totalCost(vector<int>& costs,int k,int candidates){using Worker=pair<int,int>;priority_queue<Worker,vector<Worker>,greater<Worker>> leftHeap,rightHeap;int left=0,right=costs.size()-1;while(left<=right&&(int)leftHeap.size()<candidates){leftHeap.push({costs[left],left});++left;}while(left<=right&&(int)rightHeap.size()<candidates){rightHeap.push({costs[right],right});--right;}long long answer=0;while(k--){bool takeLeft=rightHeap.empty()||(!leftHeap.empty()&&leftHeap.top()<=rightHeap.top());auto chosen=takeLeft?leftHeap.top():rightHeap.top();if(takeLeft)leftHeap.pop();else rightHeap.pop();answer+=chosen.first;if(left<=right){if(takeLeft){leftHeap.push({costs[left],left});++left;}else{rightHeap.push({costs[right],right});--right;}}}return answer;} };
